entries.en: Then, you need to see the doctor... not me.
entries.fr: Alors, vois le médecin... pas moi.

entries.en: @I can examine each one of you for $
@you don't feel so well, come and talk to a doctor.
entries.fr: @tu te sens mal, viens consulter un médecin.

entries.en: @I don't think anyone has anything like that.

entries.fr: @Je ne peux soigner que les maladies.

entries.en: @If you don't have any money, you'll just have to keep on going in your current state.
entries.fr: @Sans argent, tu devras continuer dans cet état.

entries.en: @Yeah, well, I am actually pretty busy.
@If you are the patient, come into the back room.
entries.fr: @Si tu es le patient, va dans la salle du fond.

entries.en: @We don't have a person like that in our hospital.
entries.fr: @Ce patient n'est pas dans notre hôpital.
@Reviens si tu as besoin de nous.

entries.en: @What a sad look in your eyes... you, the boy in a red cap.
entries.fr: @Tu as l'air triste, garçon au bonnet rouge...

entries.en: @Everything I just told you applies to hospitals all over the world.
entries.fr: @Cela vaut pour les hôpitaux du monde entier.

entries.en: Can I do my job well, or what!
entries.fr: Je fais du bon travail, hein !
@Hum, reviens si tu en as besoin.

entries.en: What a great doctor I am!

entries.fr: @Hum, reviens si tu en as besoin.
@Ton ami, c'est ça ? Son état est grave.

entries.en: @That's nothing you need to be ashamed of.
entries.fr: @Tu n'as pas à en avoir honte.

entries.en: @By the way, do you need any help?
@As long as you have money for the doctor's fee,
@I don't think there is anything wrong with you.

entries.fr: @Tu dois avoir le mal du pays.

entries.en: @you'll be able to see your friend completely recovered in no time.
